description: Confirm-gated credentials GET path. The Option B instance_id rejections (checked before the confirm gate) now agree across languages. The numeric and boolean bodies are the non-object shapes both languages reject rather than reporting blank credentials as a success; other non-object shapes still diverge and are tracked in the report, so do not assume this list is the whole malformed-body surface.

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This retrieves Managed Database credentials. Set confirm=true to proceed.

cases.name: rejects zero instance_id
cases.expect_error: instance_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects a numeric API response
cases.expect_api_error: Failed to retrieve PostgreSQL Managed Database credentials

cases.name: rejects a boolean API response
cases.expect_api_error: Failed to retrieve PostgreSQL Managed Database credentials
